address: New KK99 Cafe, 99 Jalan Lembah Permai, Tanjung Bungah, George Town, 11200, Malaysia
bio: This family business is now run by the third generation. Each aromatic plate of koay teow is fried to order and exudes wok hei. It tastes even better with a dab of chilli sauce. Optionally, add an over-easy egg or cheese on top....
